title.zh: John Xiao 的 DSH 插件

description.en: Notifications and small conveniences for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的通知与小工具。

description.en: Lays the sidebar's workspace list out as three columns of tiles. The switch sits in the workspace view options menu, next to Group by, labelled Grid (3 columns); it is off by default, applies immediately and is remembered. A workspace without sessions becomes a compact tile with the folder icon above a name that wraps to three lines; a workspace that holds sessions or child workspaces keeps a full row, so session titles stay readable. The opened workspace and the selected session are highlighted with the accent color. On startup the plugin also widens the sidebar to the layout's 420px maximum, which you can still drag narrower afterwards. Only the arrangement changes: clicking, drag sorting, the context menu, hover cards and new sessions use the built-in interactions. State stays in local browser storage; no workspace files are read or written.
description.zh: 把侧栏「工作区」列表排成三列瓦片。开关在「工作区」标题右边的「视图选项」菜单里，叫「九宫格（3 列）」，默认关闭，点一下即时生效并记住。开启后，没有会话的工作区变成文件夹图标在上、名称居中最多三行的小格；有会话或带子工作区的工作区仍占整行，会话列表宽度不变。点开的工作区和当前选中的会话都用强调色高亮。插件还会在启动时把侧栏宽度拉到最宽 420px（之后仍可手动拖窄）。只改排布：点击、拖拽排序、右键菜单、悬停卡片、新建会话全部沿用官方交互；数据只存在本机浏览器，不读写工作区文件。
